summary: Reviewed the REDUNDANCY-REDUCTION change set (aa6c1af..HEAD, commits 626173b + 0b0d642). All focus areas pass: LeaderboardTeaser async-composition is correct RSC usage with both boards' .catch(()=>[]) degrade paths preserved and tested (paidOn + paidOff); DuelStackShell 'chips' neutral section renders both tabs inactive with no aria regression; ClimbControlsGuide collapsible path uses native <details> (keyboard-accessible, no tabindex/aria mistakes) and the overlay/compact paths are unchanged; CTA inventory is intact — every touched destination keeps a canonical, reachable path (/duel/chips still linked from the /duel teaser; /climb reachable via FreeStackShell Leaderboard tab; /duel reachable on mobile via AccountMenu; sign-in reachable via NavbarAuth and DuelResult foot). No orphaned imports/exports from the DuelPromo/SocialProofStrip deletions (Link/Button/SIGNIN_HREF still used where kept; removed imports fully cleaned). The 3 SE skips are reasonable. No critical or warning findings — three info-level notes only.

findings.issue: Stale doc comment on getGlobalClimbStats still names SocialProofStrip as a co-caller ('multiple RSC callers in the same render pass (SocialProofStrip + HomePage)'). SocialProofStrip was deleted this change set; HomePage(Hero) is now the sole caller. The React cache() wrapper remains harmless but the rationale is outdated.
findings.fix: Update the comment to reference only HomePage/Hero, or drop the multi-caller justification.

findings.issue: The two boards are awaited sequentially (await FreeLeaderboard() then await RankedLeaderboard()), whereas the previous sibling-element form let React resolve both server reads concurrently. Under ISR (revalidate 60) both reads are cached and this is negligible, but it is a minor serialization of two independent DB reads.
findings.fix: Optional: resolve with Promise.all([FreeLeaderboard(), PAID_DUELS_ENABLED ? RankedLeaderboard() : null]) to keep the reads parallel.

findings.issue: The ranked-chips/tournaments callout gates on PAID_DUELS_ENABLED_PUBLIC (client mirror) while the ranked board gates on PAID_DUELS_ENABLED (server). If the two env vars ever diverge, a 'real cash prizes' callout could render while the ranked board (and the paid backend) is off. This is the pre-existing pattern (old DuelPromo callout used PUBLIC; RankedLeaderboard used the server flag), so it is not a regression — noting for ops: keep NEXT_PUBLIC_PAID_DUELS_ENABLED and PAID_DUELS_ENABLED set together.
findings.fix: No code change required; ensure the two flags are always deployed in lockstep (existing convention).

learnings.insight: After the dashboard/home CTA cuts, mobile reachability of /duel and /climb depends on non-obvious paths: navbar mode links are `hidden sm:inline-flex` (desktop only), so on mobile /duel and /climb are reached via AccountMenu (signed-in only) and via the FreeStackShell/DuelStackShell tab bands. When acceptance-testing 'every destination reachable', check the mobile (<640px) viewport specifically, not just desktop.
learnings.action: Run the CTA-reachability acceptance at a 375px viewport; verify AccountMenu (auth) and the stack-shell tabs expose /duel and /climb.

learnings.insight: LeaderboardTeaser composes child async server components by awaiting the function (await FreeLeaderboard()) rather than rendering <FreeLeaderboard/>. This is valid RSC (no double render, degrade .catch stays inside each child) and is unit-testable via renderToStaticMarkup(await Component()), but it serializes otherwise-parallel child reads. Prefer Promise.all when the children each do an independent I/O read.
learnings.action: When merging async server components, wrap the awaits in Promise.all to preserve concurrency.
